component.name: Circles
component.summary: Share with the people a post is for

description.p: Circles is a peer-to-peer social network built around circles: you choose exactly who each post is for, and only they can read it. There is no central server. Your identity lives on your device, posts are end-to-end encrypted to their audience, and devices sync directly, through your own always-on pod, or through relays that only ever see encrypted data.

ul.li: Post to circles or publicly, with photos
Comment, +1 and reshare; authors moderate their own threads
Find contacts on the local network automatically
Keep posts available while you're offline with a pod you run

description.p: First GNOME release: circles, photos, comments, +1s, reshares, pods and relays.
